evidence.notes: Primary manufacturer guide defines peptones as protein hydrolysates of varied animal/vegetable starting materials. Existing unqualified Peptone owner has only lexical MICRO mammalian grounding, not source-origin evidence. Own variable-material identity does not assign a particular digest or supplier.

Primary NLM concept for active descriptor D011492 defines a complex mixture produced by partial or extensive hydrolysis. Compared with the manufacturer generic partial-protein-hydrolysate definition, this supports a broader material relation only: NARROW_MATCH / native broadMatch, preserving kgmicrobe.ingredient:peptone. The descriptor indexing annotation does not establish clinical use or approve an organism/assay role.

Printed page7 defines generic peptones as water-soluble partial protein hydrolysates from plant, yeast or animal sources and includes acid, base or enzyme processing. This supports broader Protein Hydrolysates membership without selecting feedstock, enzyme, supplier, lot, numerical composition or organism role.

The direct Peptones descriptor D010461 was assessed under native section3 exact-term precedence. Its primary concept specifies acid-or-enzyme partial hydrolysis and solubility/nonprecipitation criteria. The source-unspecified owner and two observations do not establish that complete narrower specification; manufacturer generic scope also includes base hydrolysis. No exact D010461 identity is asserted merely from its matching name.

Full FOODON:03315306 class has an actual subclass restriction member_of some FOODON:03400181 food additive (us cfr), in addition to its SIREN flavoring rdfs:comment. The initial private FoodOn candidate is unselected because these source peptones do not establish that membership. This statement is a negative applicability finding; it does not edit or disapprove other owners automatically.

The complete active NLM Peptones descriptor, its explicit Peptone entry term and preferred concept M0016245 support the ordinary generic material identity. Under native section3, this supported unspecified sense takes precedence over a local fallback. The conventional partial-hydrolysis/solubility description does not create a new lot-specific assay gate when no different actual source preparation is established. This is not supplier-product or source-assay approval.

Printed page7 independently identifies generic peptones as water-soluble partial protein-hydrolysis products while explaining variable feedstocks and product profiles. Mention of possible acid, base or enzyme processing is not positive evidence that the unqualified assigned owner denotes a different preparation from the ordinary MeSH Peptones sense. Earlier process/precipitation-gate inference is superseded; no numeric composition or role is imported.

The official member_of guidance connects products to external product-type categories rather than asserting subclass identity in agency classifications. The verified FoodOn03315306 existential member_of axiom is real, but does not by itself impose food-use, has-role, regulatory approval or lot eligibility on a MIM material broader mapping. Earlier stronger negative applicability wording is retained historically and superseded here. Selection of direct generic mesh:D010461 follows the closer supported material term, not an invented FoodOn gate.
